created_by: FlameLens data team, with an SI tool
si_use: An SI tool (Claude) found NASA's FLEX Technical Publication on NTRS, wrote and ran a script, which reads Table IX from the PDF's text row by row and matches each row to the site's test by FLEX identifier and test number. The SI tool chose which sentences are findings; they are listed in REPORT.md. No value was generated or read from a plot. The team's six members have checked it. For the Guide findings the SI tool chose the sentences, and a script cuts each one word for word from the PDF's text and stops if it is not found.
summary: FLEX: NASA's own per-test results table (Table IX of NASA/TP-2015-216046) as a second witness for 276 tests, 2367 claims; it agrees with PSI's FLEX table in 3717 of 3836 cells. 10 NASA findings, mostly on the fuel-needle contamination that affects every test. Version 2: NASA's droplet and flame diameter histories (106,475 curve points, 734 curves) and its test sheets (ambient temperature, fiber, NASA's description of each burn). Version 4: 4 findings in NASA's words from NASA's ISS Researcher's Guide: Combustion Science (2015), one of the challenge's listed resources.
